title: GrowthBook header
description: A violet announcement strip over a light, hairline-bottomed nav: wordmark, plain links with small chevrons, a white GitHub-stars pill, a quiet sign-in link and outline + violet buttons. Sticky; on desktop it slides up out of the way while you scroll down and comes back when you scroll up. Phones get a burger menu.
notes: hide-on-scroll is desktop only (as on the original); off under reduced motion
the announcement strip is the brand primary with primary-foreground text
name: growthbook-header

props.name: announcement
props.type: { text: string; linkLabel: string; href: string; }
props.description: the strip above the nav; leave out to hide it

props.name: brandIcon
props.description: small mark before the wordmark (an svg or lucide icon)

props.name: stars
props.type: { icon: ReactNode; count: string; href: string; label: string; }
props.description: the white pill with a repository's star count; leave out to hide it

props.name: signIn
props.description: quiet text link before the buttons

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: accessible labels for the phone menu button
